tools.name: start_video_editing
tools.description: Prepare My AI Video Editor for this request. Returns a link to myaivideoeditor.com with the request already filled in; the user uploads their files there. Needs no account and takes no files here. Upload your raw footage. Say what you want. Get it back cut, captioned and ready to post.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: start_video_editing · Private data: start_video_editing · Public sink: start_video_editing.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: start_video_editing · Private data: start_video_editing · Public sink: start_video_editing

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
